sar.narrative: Between 2016-12-19 and 2016-12-20, cardholder C13171 experienced unauthorized activity on card C13171-K2. A total of 1 transaction(s) amounting to $55.68 USD were executed under fraud pattern 'card_not_present_fraud'. The primary flagged transaction 3558054 ($55.68) was initiated through the online channel. The same device profile was also observed across 171 other distinct cards, demonstrating coordinated compromise. The cardholder was contacted for transaction validation and stated: 'Customer states they did not make these purchases and still has the card'. The activity represents a coordinated breach consistent with regulatory typology guidance. The financial institution has blocked card C13171-K2 to mitigate further loss and placed linked accounts under enhanced monitoring.

stop_reason: Customer denial and definitive graph pattern signatures settled the verdict; further steps would not alter the defensive actions.
